about: The display part (DESIGN 1.6): a number in seven-segment digits, as on a calculator. `shows` gives the text a value becomes in `digits` digits: rounded half away from zero to fit, without trailing zeros, E when its whole part does not fit. `cells` gives what each of the display's digits + 1 cells shows, from the left: a character (space when dark) and whether its decimal point is lit; the extra cell is for the minus sign. `segments` gives the lit segments of each character: a top, b top right, c bottom right, d bottom, e bottom left, f top left, g middle. The web renderer and Avalonia run these cases.
